14 # Trigonometric functions
15 
16 ## Main definitions
17 
18 This file contains the definition of `π`.
19 
20 See also `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Inverse` and
21 `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Arctan` for the inverse trigonometric functions.
22 
23 See also `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Arg` and
24 `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Log` for the complex argument function
25 and the complex logarithm.
26 
27 ## Main statements
28 
29 Many basic inequalities on the real trigonometric functions are established.
30 
31 The continuity of the usual trigonometric functions is proved.
32 
33 Several facts about the real trigonometric functions have the proofs deferred to
34 `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Complex`,
35 as they are most easily proved by appealing to the corresponding fact for
36 complex trigonometric functions.
37 
38 See also `Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Chebyshev` for the multiple angle formulas
39 in terms of Chebyshev polynomials.
40 
41 ## Tags
42 
43 sin, cos, tan, angle

67   fun_prop

76   fun_prop

117 theorem exists_cos_eq_zero : 0 ∈ cos '' Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 :=
118   intermediate_value_Icc' (by simp) continuousOn_cos
119     ⟨le_of_lt cos_two_neg, le_of_lt cos_one_pos⟩
120 
121 /-- The number π = 3.14159265... Defined here using choice as twice a zero of cos in [1,2],
122 from which one can derive all its properties. For explicit bounds on π,
123 see `Mathlib/Analysis/Real/Pi/Bounds.lean`.
124 
125 Denoted `π`, once the `Real` namespace is opened. -/
126 protected noncomputable def pi : ℝ :=
127   2 * Classical.choose exists_cos_eq_zero
128 
129 @[inherit_doc]
130 scoped notation "π" => Real.pi
131 
132 @[simp]
133 theorem cos_pi_div_two : cos (π / 2) = 0 := by
134   rw [Real.pi, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero]
135   exact (Classical.choose_spec exists_cos_eq_zero).2
136 
137 theorem one_le_pi_div_two : (1 : ℝ) ≤ π / 2 := by
138   rw [Real.pi, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero]
139   exact (Classical.choose_spec exists_cos_eq_zero).1.1
140 
141 theorem pi_div_two_le_two : π / 2 ≤ 2 := by
142   rw [Real.pi, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero]
143   exact (Classical.choose_spec exists_cos_eq_zero).1.2
144 
145 theorem two_le_pi : (2 : ℝ) ≤ π :=
146   (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right zero_lt_two).1
147     (by rw [div_self two_ne_zero]; exact one_le_pi_div_two)
148 
149 theorem pi_le_four : π ≤ 4 :=
150   (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right zero_lt_two).1
151     (calc
152       π / 2 ≤ 2 := pi_div_two_le_two
153       _ = 4 / 2 := by norm_num)
154 
155 @[bound]
156 theorem pi_pos : 0 < π :=
157   lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) two_le_pi
158 
159 @[bound]
160 theorem pi_nonneg : 0 ≤ π :=
161   pi_pos.le
162 
163 @[simp]
164 theorem pi_ne_zero : π ≠ 0 :=
165   pi_pos.ne'
166 
167 theorem pi_div_two_pos : 0 < π / 2 :=
168   half_pos pi_pos
169 
170 theorem two_pi_pos : 0 < 2 * π := by linarith [pi_pos]
171 
172 end Real

177 /-- Extension for the `positivity` tactic: `π` is always positive. -/
178 @[positivity Real.pi]
179 meta def evalRealPi : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _zα _pα e := do
180   match u, α, e with
181   | 0, ~q(ℝ), ~q(Real.pi) =>
182     assertInstancesCommute
183     pure (.positive q(Real.pi_pos))
184   | _, _, _ => throwError "not Real.pi"
185 
186 end Mathlib.Meta.Positivity

406 theorem sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi {x : ℝ} (h0x : 0 < x) (hxp : x < π) : 0 < sin x :=
407   if hx2 : x ≤ 2 then sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_two h0x hx2
408   else sin_pi_sub x ▸ sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_two (sub_pos.2 hxp) (by linarith [pi_le_four])

415   exact

438   this.resolve_right fun h =>

481 lemma cos_half {x : ℝ} (hl : -π ≤ x) (hr : x ≤ π) : cos (x / 2) = √((1 + cos x) / 2) := by
482   have : 0 ≤ cos (x / 2) := cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc <| by constructor <;> linarith
483   rw [← sqrt_sq this, cos_sq, add_div, two_mul, add_halves]

488 lemma sin_half_eq_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hl : 0 ≤ x) (hr : x ≤ 2 * π) :
489     sin (x / 2) = √((1 - cos x) / 2) := by
490   rw [← abs_sin_half, abs_of_nonneg]
491   apply sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi <;> linarith
492 
493 lemma sin_half_eq_neg_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hl : -(2 * π) ≤ x) (hr : x ≤ 0) :
494     sin (x / 2) = -√((1 - cos x) / 2) := by
495   rw [← abs_sin_half, abs_of_nonpos, neg_neg]
496   apply sin_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_neg_pi_le <;> linarith
497 
498 theorem sin_eq_zero_iff_of_lt_of_lt {x : ℝ} (hx₁ : -π < x) (hx₂ : x < π) : sin x = 0 ↔ x = 0 :=
499   ⟨fun h => by
500     contrapose! h
501     cases h.lt_or_gt with
502     | inl h0 => exact (sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt h0 hx₁).ne
503     | inr h0 => exact (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h0 hx₂).ne',
504   fun h => by simp [h]⟩
505 
506 theorem sin_eq_zero_iff {x : ℝ} : sin x = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * π = x :=
507   ⟨fun h =>
508     ⟨⌊x / π⌋,
509       le_antisymm (sub_nonneg.1 (Int.sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg _ pi_pos))
510         (sub_nonpos.1 <|
511           le_of_not_gt fun h₃ =>
512             (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h₃ (Int.sub_floor_div_mul_lt _ pi_pos)).ne
513               (by simp [sub_eq_add_neg, sin_add, h, sin_int_mul_pi]))⟩,
514     fun ⟨_, hn⟩ => hn ▸ sin_int_mul_pi _⟩
515 
516 theorem sin_ne_zero_iff {x : ℝ} : sin x ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * π ≠ x := by
517   contrapose!; exact sin_eq_zero_iff
518 
519 theorem sin_eq_zero_iff_cos_eq {x : ℝ} : sin x = 0 ↔ cos x = 1 ∨ cos x = -1 := by
520   rw [← mul_self_eq_one_iff, ← sin_sq_add_cos_sq, sq, sq, right_eq_add, mul_eq_zero, or_self]
521 
522 theorem cos_eq_zero_iff_sin_eq {x : ℝ} : cos x = 0 ↔ sin x = 1 ∨ sin x = -1 := by
523   rw [← mul_self_eq_one_iff, ← sin_sq_add_cos_sq, sq, sq, left_eq_add, mul_eq_zero, or_self]
524 
525 theorem cos_eq_one_iff (x : ℝ) : cos x = 1 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, (n : ℝ) * (2 * π) = x :=
526   ⟨fun h =>
527     let ⟨n, hn⟩ := sin_eq_zero_iff.1 (sin_eq_zero_iff_cos_eq.2 (Or.inl h))
528     ⟨n / 2,
529       (Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one n).elim
530         (fun hn0 => by
531           rwa [← mul_assoc, ← @Int.cast_two ℝ, ← Int.cast_mul,
532             Int.ediv_mul_cancel (Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero.2 hn0)])
533         fun hn1 => by
534         rw [← Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n 2, hn1, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, add_mul, one_mul,
535           add_comm, mul_comm (2 : ℤ), Int.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Int.cast_two] at hn
536         rw [← hn, cos_int_mul_two_pi_add_pi] at h
537         exact absurd h (by norm_num)⟩,
538     fun ⟨_, hn⟩ => hn ▸ cos_int_mul_two_pi _⟩
539 
540 theorem cos_eq_one_iff_of_lt_of_lt {x : ℝ} (hx₁ : -(2 * π) < x) (hx₂ : x < 2 * π) :
541     cos x = 1 ↔ x = 0 :=
542   ⟨fun h => by
543     rcases (cos_eq_one_iff _).1 h with ⟨n, rfl⟩
544     rw [mul_lt_iff_lt_one_left two_pi_pos] at hx₂
545     rw [neg_lt, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul, mul_lt_iff_lt_one_left two_pi_pos] at hx₁
546     norm_cast at hx₁ hx₂
547     obtain rfl : n = 0 := le_antisymm (by lia) (by lia)
548     simp, fun h => by simp [h]⟩
549 
550 theorem sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two {x y : ℝ} (hx₁ : -(π / 2) ≤ x) (hy₂ : y ≤ π / 2)
551     (hxy : x < y) : sin x < sin y := by
552   rw [← sub_pos, sin_sub_sin]
553   have : 0 < sin ((y - x) / 2) := by apply sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi <;> linarith
554   have : 0 < cos ((y + x) / 2) := by refine cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
555   positivity
556 
557 theorem strictMonoOn_sin : StrictMonoOn sin (Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) := fun _ hx _ hy hxy =>
558   sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two hx.1 hy.2 hxy
559 
560 theorem monotoneOn_sin : MonotoneOn sin (Set.Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) :=
561   strictMonoOn_sin.monotoneOn
562 
563 theorem cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi {x y : ℝ} (hx₁ : 0 ≤ x) (hy₂ : y ≤ π) (hxy : x < y) :
564     cos y < cos x := by
565   rw [← sin_pi_div_two_sub, ← sin_pi_div_two_sub]
566   apply sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two <;> linarith
567 
568 theorem cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi_div_two {x y : ℝ} (hx₁ : 0 ≤ x) (hy₂ : y ≤ π / 2)
569     (hxy : x < y) : cos y < cos x :=
570   cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hx₁ (hy₂.trans (by linarith)) hxy
571 
572 theorem strictAntiOn_cos : StrictAntiOn cos (Icc 0 π) := fun _ hx _ hy hxy =>
573   cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hx.1 hy.2 hxy
574 
575 theorem antitoneOn_cos : AntitoneOn cos (Set.Icc 0 π) :=
576   strictAntiOn_cos.antitoneOn
577 
578 theorem cos_le_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi {x y : ℝ} (hx₁ : 0 ≤ x) (hy₂ : y ≤ π) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
579     cos y ≤ cos x :=
580   (strictAntiOn_cos.le_iff_ge ⟨hx₁.trans hxy, hy₂⟩ ⟨hx₁, hxy.trans hy₂⟩).2 hxy
581 
582 theorem sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two {x y : ℝ} (hx₁ : -(π / 2) ≤ x) (hy₂ : y ≤ π / 2)
583     (hxy : x ≤ y) : sin x ≤ sin y :=
584   (strictMonoOn_sin.le_iff_le ⟨hx₁, hxy.trans hy₂⟩ ⟨hx₁.trans hxy, hy₂⟩).2 hxy
585 
586 theorem injOn_sin : InjOn sin (Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) :=
587   strictMonoOn_sin.injOn
588 
589 theorem injOn_cos : InjOn cos (Icc 0 π) :=
590   strictAntiOn_cos.injOn
591 
592 theorem surjOn_sin : SurjOn sin (Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) (Icc (-1) 1) := by
593   simpa only [sin_neg, sin_pi_div_two] using
594     intermediate_value_Icc (neg_le_self pi_div_two_pos.le) continuous_sin.continuousOn
595 
596 theorem surjOn_cos : SurjOn cos (Icc 0 π) (Icc (-1) 1) := by
597   simpa only [cos_zero, cos_pi] using intermediate_value_Icc' pi_pos.le continuous_cos.continuousOn
598 
599 theorem sin_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : sin x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
600   ⟨neg_one_le_sin x, sin_le_one x⟩
601 
602 theorem cos_mem_Icc (x : ℝ) : cos x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
603   ⟨neg_one_le_cos x, cos_le_one x⟩
604 
605 theorem mapsTo_sin (s : Set ℝ) : MapsTo sin s (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := fun x _ => sin_mem_Icc x
606 
607 theorem mapsTo_cos (s : Set ℝ) : MapsTo cos s (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := fun x _ => cos_mem_Icc x
608 
609 theorem bijOn_sin : BijOn sin (Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) (Icc (-1) 1) :=
610   ⟨mapsTo_sin _, injOn_sin, surjOn_sin⟩
611 
612 theorem bijOn_cos : BijOn cos (Icc 0 π) (Icc (-1) 1) :=
613   ⟨mapsTo_cos _, injOn_cos, surjOn_cos⟩

615 @[simp]
616 theorem range_cos : range cos = (Icc (-1) 1 : Set ℝ) :=
617   Subset.antisymm (range_subset_iff.2 cos_mem_Icc) surjOn_cos.subset_range
618 
619 @[simp]
620 theorem range_sin : range sin = (Icc (-1) 1 : Set ℝ) :=
621   Subset.antisymm (range_subset_iff.2 sin_mem_Icc) surjOn_sin.subset_range
622 
623 theorem range_cos_infinite : (range Real.cos).Infinite := by
624   rw [Real.range_cos]
625   exact Icc_infinite (by simp)
626 
627 theorem range_sin_infinite : (range Real.sin).Infinite := by
628   rw [Real.range_sin]
629   exact Icc_infinite (by simp)

631 section CosDivSq

633 variable (x : ℝ)

635 /-- the series `sqrtTwoAddSeries x n` is `sqrt(2 + sqrt(2 + ... ))` with `n` square roots,
636   starting with `x`. We define it here because `cos (pi / 2 ^ (n+1)) = sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n / 2`
637 -/
638 @[simp]
639 noncomputable def sqrtTwoAddSeries (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
640   | 0 => x
641   | n + 1 => √(2 + sqrtTwoAddSeries x n)
642 
643 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero : sqrtTwoAddSeries x 0 = x := by simp
644 
645 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_one : sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 1 = √2 := by simp
646 
647 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_two : sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 2 = √(2 + √2) := by simp
648 
649 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n
650   | 0 => le_refl 0
651   | _ + 1 => sqrt_nonneg _
652 
653 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_nonneg {x : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x) : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ sqrtTwoAddSeries x n
654   | 0 => h
655   | _ + 1 => sqrt_nonneg _
656 
657 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two : ∀ n : ℕ, sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n < 2
658   | 0 => by simp
659   | n + 1 => by
660     refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (sqrt_sq zero_lt_two.le).le
661     rw [sqrtTwoAddSeries, sqrt_lt_sqrt_iff, ← lt_sub_iff_add_lt']
662     · refine (sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two n).trans_le ?_
663       norm_num
664     · exact add_nonneg zero_le_two (sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero_nonneg n)
665 
666 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_succ (x : ℝ) :
667     ∀ n : ℕ, sqrtTwoAddSeries x (n + 1) = sqrtTwoAddSeries (√(2 + x)) n
668   | 0 => rfl
669   | n + 1 => by rw [sqrtTwoAddSeries, sqrtTwoAddSeries_succ _ _, sqrtTwoAddSeries]
670 
671 @[gcongr]
672 theorem sqrtTwoAddSeries_monotone_left {x y : ℝ} (h : x ≤ y) :
673     ∀ n : ℕ, sqrtTwoAddSeries x n ≤ sqrtTwoAddSeries y n
674   | 0 => h
675   | n + 1 => by
676     rw [sqrtTwoAddSeries, sqrtTwoAddSeries]; gcongr; exact sqrtTwoAddSeries_monotone_left h _
677 
678 @[simp]
679 theorem cos_pi_over_two_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, cos (π / 2 ^ (n + 1)) = sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n / 2
680   | 0 => by simp
681   | n + 1 => by
682     have A : (1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ one_lt_two n.succ_ne_zero
683     have B : π / 2 ^ (n + 1) < π := div_lt_self pi_pos A
684     have C : 0 < π / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by positivity
685     rw [pow_succ, div_mul_eq_div_div, cos_half, cos_pi_over_two_pow n, sqrtTwoAddSeries,
686       add_div_eq_mul_add_div, one_mul, ← div_mul_eq_div_div, sqrt_div, sqrt_mul_self] <;>
687       linarith [sqrtTwoAddSeries_nonneg le_rfl n]
688 
689 theorem sin_sq_pi_over_two_pow (n : ℕ) :
690     sin (π / 2 ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2 = 1 - (sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n / 2) ^ 2 := by
691   rw [sin_sq, cos_pi_over_two_pow]
692 
693 theorem sin_sq_pi_over_two_pow_succ (n : ℕ) :
694     sin (π / 2 ^ (n + 2)) ^ 2 = 1 / 2 - sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n / 4 := by
695   rw [sin_sq_pi_over_two_pow, sqrtTwoAddSeries, div_pow, sq_sqrt, add_div, ← sub_sub]
696   · congr
697     · norm_num
698     · norm_num
699   · exact add_nonneg two_pos.le (sqrtTwoAddSeries_zero_nonneg _)
700 
701 @[simp]
702 theorem sin_pi_over_two_pow_succ (n : ℕ) :
703     sin (π / 2 ^ (n + 2)) = √(2 - sqrtTwoAddSeries 0 n) / 2 := by
704   rw [eq_div_iff_mul_eq two_ne_zero, eq_comm, sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq, mul_pow,
705     sin_sq_pi_over_two_pow_succ, sub_mul]
706   · congr <;> norm_num
707   · rw [sub_nonneg]
708     exact (sqrtTwoAddSeries_lt_two _).le
709   refine mul_nonneg (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ?_ ?_) zero_le_two
710   · positivity
711   · exact div_le_self pi_pos.le <| one_le_pow₀ one_le_two
712 
713 @[simp]
714 theorem cos_pi_div_four : cos (π / 4) = √2 / 2 := by
715   trans cos (π / 2 ^ 2)
716   · congr
717     norm_num
718   · simp
719 
720 @[simp]
721 theorem sin_pi_div_four : sin (π / 4) = √2 / 2 := by
722   trans sin (π / 2 ^ 2)
723   · congr
724     norm_num
725   · simp

727 @[simp]
728 theorem cos_pi_div_eight : cos (π / 8) = √(2 + √2) / 2 := by
729   trans cos (π / 2 ^ 3)

731     norm_num
732   · simp

735 theorem sin_pi_div_eight : sin (π / 8) = √(2 - √2) / 2 := by
736   trans sin (π / 2 ^ 3)

738     norm_num
739   · simp

742 theorem cos_pi_div_sixteen : cos (π / 16) = √(2 + √(2 + √2)) / 2 := by
743   trans cos (π / 2 ^ 4)

755 @[simp]
756 theorem cos_pi_div_thirty_two : cos (π / 32) = √(2 + √(2 + √(2 + √2))) / 2 := by

769 -- This section is also a convenient location for other explicit values of `sin` and `cos`.
770 /-- The cosine of `π / 3` is `1 / 2`. -/
771 @[simp]
772 theorem cos_pi_div_three : cos (π / 3) = 1 / 2 := by
773   have h₁ : (2 * cos (π / 3) - 1) ^ 2 * (2 * cos (π / 3) + 2) = 0 := by
774     have : cos (3 * (π / 3)) = cos π := by
775       congr 1
776       ring
777     linarith [cos_pi, cos_three_mul (π / 3)]
778   rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h₁ with h | h
779   · linarith [eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero h]
780   · have : cos π < cos (π / 3) := by
781       refine cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ?_ le_rfl ?_ <;> linarith [pi_pos]
782     linarith [cos_pi]
783 
784 /-- The cosine of `π / 6` is `√3 / 2`. -/
785 @[simp]
786 theorem cos_pi_div_six : cos (π / 6) = √3 / 2 := by
787   rw [show (6 : ℝ) = 3 * 2 by norm_num, div_mul_eq_div_div, cos_half, cos_pi_div_three, one_add_div,
788     ← div_mul_eq_div_div, two_add_one_eq_three, sqrt_div, sqrt_mul_self] <;> linarith [pi_pos]
789 
790 /-- The square of the cosine of `π / 6` is `3 / 4` (this is sometimes more convenient than the
791 result for cosine itself). -/
792 theorem sq_cos_pi_div_six : cos (π / 6) ^ 2 = 3 / 4 := by
793   rw [cos_pi_div_six, div_pow, sq_sqrt] <;> norm_num
794 
795 /-- The sine of `π / 6` is `1 / 2`. -/
796 @[simp]
797 theorem sin_pi_div_six : sin (π / 6) = 1 / 2 := by
798   rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← cos_pi_div_three]
799   congr
800   ring
801 
802 /-- The square of the sine of `π / 3` is `3 / 4` (this is sometimes more convenient than the
803 result for cosine itself). -/
804 theorem sq_sin_pi_div_three : sin (π / 3) ^ 2 = 3 / 4 := by
805   rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← sq_cos_pi_div_six]
806   congr
807   ring

809 /-- The sine of `π / 3` is `√3 / 2`. -/
810 @[simp]
811 theorem sin_pi_div_three : sin (π / 3) = √3 / 2 := by
812   rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← cos_pi_div_six]
813   congr
814   ring

816 theorem quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five :
817     letI c := cos (π / 5)
818     4 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c - 1 = 0 := by
819   set θ := π / 5 with hθ
820   set c := cos θ
821   set s := sin θ
822   suffices 2 * c = 4 * c ^ 2 - 1 by simp [this]
823   have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
824     rw [ne_eq, sin_eq_zero_iff, hθ]
825     push Not
826     intro n hn
827     replace hn : n * 5 = 1 := by field_simp at hn; norm_cast at hn
828     lia
829   suffices s * (2 * c) = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) from mul_left_cancel₀ hs this
830   calc s * (2 * c) = 2 * s * c := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm 2]
831                  _ = sin (2 * θ) := by rw [sin_two_mul]
832                  _ = sin (π - 2 * θ) := by rw [sin_pi_sub]
833                  _ = sin (2 * θ + θ) := by congr; linarith
834                  _ = sin (2 * θ) * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := sin_add (2 * θ) θ
835                  _ = 2 * s * c * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := by rw [sin_two_mul]
836                  _ = 2 * s * c * c + (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) * s := by rw [cos_two_mul]
837                  _ = s * (2 * c * c) + s * (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
838                  _ = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
839 
840 open Polynomial in
841 theorem Polynomial.isRoot_cos_pi_div_five :
842     (4 • X ^ 2 - 2 • X - C 1 : ℝ[X]).IsRoot (cos (π / 5)) := by
843   simpa using quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five
844 
845 /-- The cosine of `π / 5` is `(1 + √5) / 4`. -/
846 @[simp]
847 theorem cos_pi_div_five : cos (π / 5) = (1 + √5) / 4 := by
848   set c := cos (π / 5)
849   have : 4 * (c * c) + (-2) * c + (-1) = 0 := by
850     rw [← sq, neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
851     exact quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five
852   have hd : discrim 4 (-2) (-1) = (2 * √5) * (2 * √5) := by norm_num [discrim, mul_mul_mul_comm]
853   rcases (quadratic_eq_zero_iff (by simp) hd c).mp this with h | h
854   · simp [h]; linarith
855   · absurd (show 0 ≤ c from cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc <| by constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos.le])
856     rw [not_le, h]
857     exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num [lt_sqrt]) (by positivity)
858 
859 end CosDivSq

861 /-- `Real.sin` as an `OrderIso` between `[-(π / 2), π / 2]` and `[-1, 1]`. -/
862 def sinOrderIso : Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2) ≃o Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 :=
863   (strictMonoOn_sin.orderIso _ _).trans <| OrderIso.setCongr _ _ bijOn_sin.image_eq
864

866 theorem coe_sinOrderIso_apply (x : Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) : (sinOrderIso x : ℝ) = sin x :=
867   rfl
868 
869 theorem sinOrderIso_apply (x : Icc (-(π / 2)) (π / 2)) : sinOrderIso x = ⟨sin x, sin_mem_Icc x⟩ :=
870   rfl

872 @[simp]
873 theorem tan_pi_div_four : tan (π / 4) = 1 := by
874   rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, cos_pi_div_four, sin_pi_div_four]
875   have h : √2 / 2 > 0 := by positivity
876   exact div_self (ne_of_gt h)

878 @[simp]
879 theorem tan_pi_div_two : tan (π / 2) = 0 := by simp [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
880 
881 @[simp]
882 theorem tan_pi_div_six : tan (π / 6) = 1 / √3 := by
883   rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, sin_pi_div_six, cos_pi_div_six]
884   ring

886 @[simp]
887 theorem tan_pi_div_three : tan (π / 3) = √3 := by
888   rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, sin_pi_div_three, cos_pi_div_three]
889   ring
890 
891 theorem tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two {x : ℝ} (h0x : 0 < x) (hxp : x < π / 2) : 0 < tan x := by
892   rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
893   exact div_pos (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h0x (by linarith)) (cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith, hxp⟩)
894 
895 theorem tan_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi_div_two {x : ℝ} (h0x : 0 ≤ x) (hxp : x ≤ π / 2) : 0 ≤ tan x :=
896   match lt_or_eq_of_le h0x, lt_or_eq_of_le hxp with
897   | Or.inl hx0, Or.inl hxp => le_of_lt (tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hx0 hxp)
898   | Or.inl _, Or.inr hxp => by simp [hxp, tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
899   | Or.inr hx0, _ => by simp [hx0.symm]

901 theorem tan_neg_of_neg_of_pi_div_two_lt {x : ℝ} (hx0 : x < 0) (hpx : -(π / 2) < x) : tan x < 0 :=

1241 /-- A supporting lemma for the **Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in a horizontal strip. If `z : ℂ`
1242 belongs to a horizontal strip `|Complex.im z| ≤ b`, `b ≤ π / 2`, and `a ≤ 0`, then
1243 $$\left|exp^{a\left(e^{z}+e^{-z}\right)}\right| \le e^{a\cos b \exp^{|re z|}}.$$
1244 -/
1245 theorem norm_exp_mul_exp_add_exp_neg_le_of_abs_im_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 0) {z : ℂ}
1246     (hz : |z.im| ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ π / 2) :
1247     ‖exp (a * (exp z + exp (-z)))‖ ≤ Real.exp (a * Real.cos b * Real.exp |z.re|) := by
1248   simp only [norm_exp, Real.exp_le_exp, re_ofReal_mul, add_re, exp_re, neg_im, Real.cos_neg, ←
1249     add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.cos b), neg_re, ← Real.cos_abs z.im]
1250   have : Real.exp |z.re| ≤ Real.exp z.re + Real.exp (-z.re) :=
1251     apply_abs_le_add_of_nonneg (fun x => (Real.exp_pos x).le) z.re
1252   refine mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (mul_le_mul this ?_ ?_ ((Real.exp_pos _).le.trans this)) ha
1253   · exact
1254       Real.cos_le_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (_root_.abs_nonneg _)
1255         (hb.trans <| half_le_self <| Real.pi_pos.le) hz
1256   · refine Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨?_, hb⟩
1257     exact (neg_nonpos.2 <| Real.pi_div_two_pos.le).trans ((_root_.abs_nonneg _).trans hz)
1258
